proof_body:
by
  intro f c z r hf hz
  have h := Complex.hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball hf hz
  have he : (fun n : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n f c / (n.factorial : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ n) = fun n : ℕ => ((n.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹ • (z - c) ^ n • iteratedDeriv n f c := by
    funext n
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact h
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c z : ℂ) (r : ℝ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c r) → z ∈ Metric.ball c r → HasSum (fun n : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n f c / (n.factorial : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ n) (f z)
